newsitem.title: SWEDEN: RESEARCH ALERT - P&U earnings forecast cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - P&U earnings forecast cut.

text.p: CS First Boston lowered its profit forecast for U.S./Swedish drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn but retained a buy recommendation on the stock.
In a research note, CS First Boston said the move followed the company's announcement last week that it now expected flat earnings of $0.44 a share for the third quarter.
"As a result we are lowering our earnings expectations," the company said.
For the full year 1996 it cut its forecast to 12.6 crowns a share from a previous estimate of 13.9 crowns ($1.90 versus $2.10).
The forecast for 1997 was cut to 14.9 crowns ($2.25) from 17 and for 1998 to 18.2 crowns ($2.75) from 19.8.
"Based on our revised 1998 estimated earnings per share we are lowering our price target for P&U from $50 to $45 based on a 10-15 percent premium to the market," the broker said.
"We do not, however, expect a quick recovery from current share price levels as management will have to win back investors' confidence in their ability to manage the business in the near term.
"Cost-cutting, a major driver to 1997 earnings, will have to show up in financial results and better hedging policies will have to be initiated and proven before that confidence is regained.
"Thus our buy recommendation is reserved for investors with a time frame of more than six months."
P&U shares closed 4.50 crowns lower at 239 crowns on the Swedish bourse on Monday.
